teachingText: When Blue first reaches the radio-sailing zone, the boats are already overlapped. Yellow is outside and must continue giving inside boat Blue mark-room while rule 18 applies, even as they approach the mark.

provenance.title: Racing Rules of Sailing 2025-2028
provenance.pageOrSection: Definitions: Mark-Room and Zone; Part 2, rules 11, 18.1, and 18.2(a)(1); Appendix E1.1
provenance.notes: World Sailing is authoritative for the rule logic and four-hull-length radio-sailing zone. The mark placement, required side, boat geometry, relationships, and MarkRoom transcription are authored training content and remain unverified.

verification.notes: The World Sailing source is authoritative; this authored two-position geometry and MarkRoom transcription have not been human-verified.
